# Post-broadcast regeneration — one command, every generated file

After the v8 broadcast writes the deployed addresses back into `ops/markets/tier1.json`
(`ops/markets/write-back-v8.mjs --deployment <DeployV8 out>`), every file this repository renders from
the registry is stale until its generator runs again. The indexer and keeper images carry only their own
package, so the committed projections **are** the registry as far as production is concerned; a stale
one ships the pre-broadcast view. This is the one command that closes the gap:

```
node ops/v2/post-broadcast-regen.mjs --registry ops/markets/tier1.json
git diff --stat        # review what moved, then commit it together with the written-back registry
```

It proves the registry first (`build-markets.mjs --check`, chain + feed directory, ~90 s), then runs
every generator, then each generator's own `--check` against what it just wrote, and prints the files
changed with line counts. It commits nothing. It exits 1 — and says which step — if any check
disagrees, so a green exit is the statement "every projection matches the registry".

## What it regenerates, and how it knows

The generators are **not typed into the runner**. Every generated file in this repository names its
generator in its header — `// GENERATED by web/scripts/gen-markets.mjs from ops/markets/tier1.json`,
`# GENERATED by ops/v2-env.mjs from …`, `/** Generated by scripts/gen-reward-epochs.mjs; … */` — and the
runner walks `git ls-files`, reads those headers, and joins the discovered set to a table of *recipes*
(how each generator is invoked: working directory, flags, what it reads). A header-less
`*.generated.json` (JSON cannot carry a comment) is attributed by the recipe of the script that writes
it. The run **refuses before touching anything** when

- a generated file names a generator the table has no recipe for (a generator landed without the
  runner learning to run it — the drift a hand-typed list hides),
- a header names a generator that exists neither at the repository root nor in the file's package,
- a `*.generated.*` file has no header and no recipe names it,
- a recipe has no discovered output at all (the table is stale), or
- a generator's `--check` exits non-zero after its write.

`--list` prints the enumeration and exits; this is what it says at callhouse `52c4741d`:

| generator | outputs | reads | `--registry` |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ops/markets/build-markets.mjs` | `tier1.json`, `dev.json` | chain 4663 + Chainlink feed directory | the SOURCE: only its `--check` runs (`--no-registry-check` skips it) |
| `web/scripts/gen-markets.mjs` | `web/lib/markets.generated.ts` | registry | yes |
| `indexer/scripts/gen-v2-registry.mjs` | `indexer/lib/v2/marketRegistry.generated.ts` | registry | yes |
| `indexer/scripts/gen-card-registry.mjs` | `indexer/lib/v2/cardRegistry.generated.json` (header-less) | registry | yes |
| `ops/v2-env.mjs` | `ops/v2/env/*.env` (6; the 6 under `env-dev/` render from `dev.json` and are left alone) | registry | yes |
| `ops/keeper-env.sh` | `ops/keeper/markets/*.env` (35, v1 run-off) | registry | yes |
| `ops/markets/render-docs.mjs` | `product/markets.md` in the docs repo — rendered to `--docs-out` only | registry (canonical path only) | no |
| `web/scripts/gen-abis.mjs`, `indexer/scripts/gen-abis.mjs`, `keeper/scripts/gen-abis.mjs` | 22 / 28 / 22 ABI modules (+ `accessManagerRoles.generated.ts`) | `ops/abis/v2/*.json`, `roles.json` | n/a — fixed input, re-run and checked for completeness |
| `indexer/scripts/gen-reward-epochs.mjs` | `indexer/lib/v2/rewardEpochFiles.generated.ts` | reward epoch files | n/a |
| `ops/fixtures/api/v2/gen.mjs` | `web/lib/v2/api-schema.test.ts` + the API fixtures | its own hand-written scenario | n/a |

Listed and **not re-run** (with the reason, so the enumeration is complete): `ops/recon/r13-probe.mjs`
and `ops/recon/r14-stockloan-probe.mjs` (one-shot network probes whose outputs are inputs),
`ops/v2/rehearse/5-report.mjs` (a dated rehearsal record).

Order: registry proof → the registry projections → the fixed-input projections → docs.

## Docs never leave the sandbox

`render-docs.mjs` writes the page to `--docs-out DIR` (default: a fresh directory under the system
temp dir; the path is printed) and re-checks it there. `../callhouse-docs` is **never written** from this
command — publishing the docs repository is owner-gated. If a `callhouse-docs` checkout sits beside the
main checkout (or beside the workspace, for a worktree under `wt/`), a read-only `diff --stat` against
its page is printed; `--docs-dir DIR` points at another checkout. In `--check` mode the render step asks
the only meaningful read-only question — is that checkout's page in sync with the registry? — and is
skipped, by name, when there is no checkout.

## Modes

| invocation | does |
|---|---|
| `node ops/v2/post-broadcast-regen.mjs --registry ops/markets/tier1.json` | launch night: prove, regenerate everything, re-check, print the diff |
| `… --check` | write nothing; each generator's `--check` only; exit 1 on any drift (the pre-flight) |
| `… --no-registry-check` | skip the ~90 s chain/feed proof of the registry (drills; a registry with synthetic addresses) |
| `… --only web/scripts/gen-markets.mjs,ops/v2-env.mjs` | run these recipes only; the enumeration still runs in full |
| `… --list` | print the enumeration (recipes, outputs, exclusions, refusals) and exit |
| `… --registry other.json` | REHEARSAL: generators that take `--registry` render from that file and mark their output `(REHEARSAL, do not commit)`; render-docs is skipped; the run ends with a do-not-commit line |

To drill the real launch-night flow, copy the written-back registry **over** `ops/markets/tier1.json`
in a scratch worktree and run with the canonical path — that is exactly what launch night does — then
`git checkout -- .` the tree.

## Drill record — 2026-09-22, callhouse `52c4741ded4f7b685eb6008207331f9a25f59da7`

Run 4's written-back registry did not exist when this was written (T-OP-165's dry run was still on the
contracts side), so the drill used a **synthetic** write-back: a deployment record in the exact shape
`DeployV8.s.sol toJson` emits (the `ops/markets/write-back-v8.test.mjs` `record()` shape: eleven
top-level contracts, `sources`, `flywheel` with `deployBlock`, `safes`, `wallets.guardian`, `bots`), with
sixteen digit-only synthetic addresses `0x…0001`–`0x…0016` (their EIP-55 form is themselves), the real
Safes, guardian and bot keys from the registry, and `deployBlock` 69,500,000, written through the real
`write-back-v8.mjs` (`wrote 20 path(s)`), then copied over the tree's `tier1.json`.
`--no-registry-check` was necessary: the chain has no code at synthetic addresses, so
`build-markets.mjs --check` would refuse them by design.

Per-generator summary, verbatim from the run:

```
  skipped                ops/markets/build-markets.mjs            (--no-registry-check)
  ok                     indexer/scripts/gen-card-registry.mjs    0 file(s) changed, +0 -0
  ok                     indexer/scripts/gen-v2-registry.mjs      1 file(s) changed, +26 -20
  ok                     ops/keeper-env.sh                        0 file(s) changed, +0 -0
  ok                     ops/v2-env.mjs                           2 file(s) changed, +44 -44
  ok                     web/scripts/gen-markets.mjs              1 file(s) changed, +15 -15
  ok                     indexer/scripts/gen-abis.mjs             0 file(s) changed, +0 -0
  ok                     indexer/scripts/gen-reward-epochs.mjs    0 file(s) changed, +0 -0
  ok                     keeper/scripts/gen-abis.mjs              0 file(s) changed, +0 -0
  ok                     ops/fixtures/api/v2/gen.mjs              0 file(s) changed, +0 -0
  ok                     web/scripts/gen-abis.mjs                 0 file(s) changed, +0 -0
  ok                     ops/markets/render-docs.mjs              0 file(s) changed, +0 -0   (rendered to --docs-out; vs callhouse-docs: differs)
```

`git diff --stat` after it: `indexer/lib/v2/marketRegistry.generated.ts | 46`, `ops/markets/tier1.json |
52`, `ops/v2/env/cranker.env | 8`, `ops/v2/env/indexer-v2.env | 80`, `web/lib/markets.generated.ts | 30`;
every generator's `--check` green after its write; exit 0. The card registry and the v1 keeper envs do
not read `v2.contracts`, so a v2 write-back moves neither — expected, and the summary says so.

**Two projections were already stale at the tip, before any write-back.** The first run on the
committed registry (no drill file) changed `indexer/lib/v2/marketRegistry.generated.ts` (+8/−2: the six
externals `houseVault`, `houseVaultFactory`, `hedger`, `rewardsDistributorLender`, `earnVault`,
`stockVenueAdapter` as `null`, and the two Safes) and `ops/v2/env/indexer-v2.env` (+8/−8: `V2_TOKEN`,
`V2_TOKEN_DECIMALS`, `V2_ADMIN_SAFE`, `V2_TREASURY_SAFE` filled from the registry). Their own checks
were red at `52c4741d` (`gen-v2-registry.mjs --check` rc=1, `v2-env.mjs --check` rc=1): T-OP-108/111/114/156
landed registry keys without re-running these two generators. Reported to the coordinator
(M-71a7ac383a8840f6); not committed here (this row is new files only). The launch-night run regenerates
both — that is how they were found.

`--check` (no write) at the tip, for the record: exit 1 naming exactly those two, plus render-docs
reporting the `callhouse-docs` checkout's page as drifted from the registry (the docs publish is a
separate, owner-gated step).

## When the real written-back registry exists

```
node ops/v2/post-broadcast-regen.mjs --registry ops/markets/tier1.json
```

with the registry check ON. `build-markets.mjs --check` then proves the written-back addresses on chain
(code present, sources/pools checked at a block it prints) before anything is rendered from them. Review
`git diff --stat`, commit the registry and the regenerated files in one commit, and only then build
the images. Publishing `product/markets.md` to the docs repository is a separate owner-gated step; the
rendered page is in the `--docs-out` directory the run printed.

## Tests

```
node --test ops/v2/post-broadcast-regen.test.mjs
```

Pure tests on synthetic trees produce every refusal by name (unknown generator, missing generator,
header-less orphan, stale recipe, missing script); integration tests enumerate the real tree with zero
refusals and pin the registry-projection set (`gen-markets`, `gen-v2-registry`, `gen-card-registry`,
`v2-env`, `keeper-env`) as recipes that accept `--registry`, so a new registry consumer without that
flag goes red here first.
